verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers spend management and employee reimbursement, so a mileage and per-diem story is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions mileage logging, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. Its receipt-capture AI and general reimbursement claims are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
